options.text: Sulphur powder and nitrogen gas are elements because each is a pure substance made of only one kind of identical particle.
Sugar crystals are an element because the sample looks uniform and pure.
Sulphur powder is an element even if its particles were of two different kinds mixed together.
Nitrogen gas is a compound because each nitrogen molecule contains more than one nitrogen particle joined together.

stem:
Krish studies three pure samples in the lab: sulphur powder made of only sulphur particles; sugar crystals made of particles that each contain carbon, hydrogen and oxygen joined together; and nitrogen gas made of identical molecules that each contain only nitrogen.

Which claim correctly classifies a substance as an element?

teacher.key_rationale: An element is a pure substance of identical particles of one kind. Sulphur and nitrogen fit; sugar has more than one kind of atom joined, so it is a compound. Uniform look or multi-atom molecules of one element do not change that test.
